scope: Native Web Locks/localStorage/dialog/forms; synthetic fixture and records; isolated nonpersistent browser context; all network intercepted

checks.case: two real tabs queued behind native lock; manual UI saves both records
native five-second timeout removes pending request, keeps form draft, no late write; manual retry succeeds
closing native lock owner releases lock; queued tab recovers

limitations: Synthetic fixture, not full product/backend end-to-end
No OS suspension/process crash/browser quota test
Existing old-version tabs do not participate in lock
No real model call or medical validation
